title: Views & Surface Area
tagline: Seeing the cubes you cannot see — and counting the faces you can. Read the tallest stack in every line of sight, then add every face and take away the hidden ones.
credit: Based on The Learning Lab · Views & Surface Area (G6–G7 contest prep, Instructor: Sam Cai, MSc). Contest questions from Kangaroo (2013, 2014, 2020), CJMC Gray Jay 2020 and Gauss (2018, 2023) — used here for personal study.

pages.title: The Quest
pages.desc: Build stacks, read their views, count hidden cubes, then box surfaces, glued cubes, scaling and tilting — play with each idea, then solve step by step.

pages.title: Practice
pages.desc: Every question from the slides — Together and Your turn — with a hands-on lab after each one. Do them on paper first, then check here.
